origin: EKS JC emerged from a unique partnership born from the ashes of previous ventures. EKS, initially established by Mattias Ekström as a World Rallycross Championship powerhouse, had scaled back its operations. JC Raceteknik, a prominent name in Swedish rallycross known for its driver development program, saw an opportunity. Joel Christoffersson, the driving force behind JC Raceteknik, approached Ekström with a proposition: a joint venture that would combine JC's expertise in nurturing young talent with EKS's remaining infrastructure and brand recognition. The initial years were a blend of high expectations and the realities of building a new team identity, but the partnership proved resilient, navigating early setbacks with a shared vision for success.
philosophy: EKS JC's racing philosophy centers around nurturing young talent and providing them with the resources to compete at the highest level. They prioritize a data-driven approach to car development, leveraging both simulation and on-track testing to optimize performance. The team fosters a collaborative and supportive environment, encouraging open communication and shared learning experiences between drivers and engineers. They believe that a strong team culture is essential for achieving consistent success.
achievements: Multiple podium finishes in the FIA European Rallycross Championship
Victory in select rounds of the Swedish Rallycross Championship
Successful development and promotion of several young drivers to international rallycross series
Consistent top-ten finishes in the FIA RX2e Championship

teamPrincipal.name: Joel Christoffersson
teamPrincipal.background: Joel Christoffersson is a seasoned rallycross manager and team owner with a proven track record in driver development. He is known for his hands-on approach and ability to motivate his team to perform under pressure.

keyFigures.name: Mattias Ekström
keyFigures.description: A legendary rallycross driver and founder of EKS, Mattias Ekström provides invaluable guidance and mentorship to the team, drawing upon his extensive experience and knowledge of the sport.

keyFigures.name: Jan-Erik Steen
keyFigures.description: Jan-Erik Steen is a highly experienced engineer responsible for overseeing the team's car development and technical strategy. He has a meticulous approach and a knack for finding performance gains in unexpected areas.

headquarters: EKS JC operates from a modest but well-equipped facility in Sweden, featuring a workshop for car preparation, a simulation lab, and office space for the team's engineers and management. While not as expansive as some of the larger professional teams, the headquarters provides a functional and efficient environment for the team's operations.
fanBase: EKS JC's fan base is predominantly Swedish, drawn to the team's focus on developing local talent and their commitment to rallycross. They are known for their passionate support at races, waving Swedish flags and cheering on the team's drivers. The team actively engages with its fans through social media, providing behind-the-scenes content and updates on their progress.
